account_token.description: Globally unique identifier denoting the account that the associated transaction occurred on.

card_program_token.description: Globally unique identifier denoting the card program that the associated transaction occurred on.

card_token.description: Globally unique identifier denoting the card that the associated transaction occurred on.

created.description: Date and time when the transaction first occurred. UTC time zone.

disputes_gross_amount.description: The total gross amount of disputes settlements.

event_tokens.description: Array of globally unique identifiers for the financial events that comprise this settlement. Use these tokens to access detailed event-level information.

fee_description.description: Network's description of a fee, only present on records with type `FEE`.

institution.description: The most granular ID the network settles with (e.g., ICA for Mastercard, FTSRE for Visa).

interchange_fee_extended_precision.description: The total amount of interchange in six-digit extended precision.

network.description: Card network where the transaction took place.

other_fees_details.description: The total gross amount of other fees by type.

other_fees_gross_amount.description: Total amount of gross other fees outside of interchange.

report_date.description: Date of when the report was first generated.

settlement_date.description: Date of when money movement is triggered for the transaction. One exception applies - for Mastercard dual message settlement, this is the settlement advisement date, which is distinct from the date of money movement.

token.description: Globally unique identifier denoting the Settlement Detail.

transaction_token.description: Globally unique identifier denoting the associated transaction. For settlement records with type `CLEARING`, `FINANCIAL`, or `NON-FINANCIAL`, this references a card transaction token. For settlement records with type `CHARGEBACK`, `REPRESENTMENT`, `PREARBITRATION`, `ARBITRATION`, or `COLLABORATION`, this references the dispute transaction token. May be null for certain settlement types.

transactions_gross_amount.description: The total amount of settlement impacting transactions (excluding interchange, fees, and disputes).

updated.description: Date and time when the transaction first occurred. UTC time zone.
